title: Separation Is a Riesz Energy: How Many Environments Does ICA Need?
abstract: arXiv:2611.06228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the number of components $d$ grows? We answer both for the joint diagonalization of $K$ covariances. Each component has a signature, its variances across the environments. Separating component $j$ costs the Riesz 2-energy $E_j$ of this signature, a sum, over the other components, of inverse pairwise Fisher informations. For Gaussian sources no estimator in $O(d)$ beats $cE_j/(n+E_j)$ at any $n$ and $d$, and above an explicit sample size a spectral estimator attains $E_j/n$ up to a constant, for every mixing and without the signatures (given a lower bound on the pairwise information). translated_title: 分离即是一种 Riesz 能量：ICA 需要多少个环境？
translated_abstract: 当所有独立成分都是高斯分布时，独立成分还能被恢复吗？答案是肯定的，只要它们的方差在不同环境之间发生变化；但随着成分数量 $d$ 的增长，需要多少个环境，以及多少个样本？本文针对 $K$ 个协方差矩阵的联合对角化问题回答了这两个问题。每个成分都有一个“特征签名”，即它在各环境中的方差。分离第 $j$ 个成分的代价等于该签名的 Riesz 2-能量 $E_j$，即在其余成分上成对费希尔信息倒数之和。对于高斯源，在任何 $n$ 和 $d$ 下，$O(d)$ 复杂度内没有任何估计器能超越 $cE_j/(n+E_j)$；而在超过某个明确的样本量阈值之后，谱估计器在常数因子内即可达到 $E_j/n$ 的速率，且该结论适用于任意混合方式、无需预知特征签名（仅需给出成对信息的下界）。由于特征签名生活在 $K-1$ 维空间中，其速率遵循一个维度定律：$K=2$ 时为 $d^2/n$，$K=3$ 时为 $d\log d/n$，而 $K\ge4$（环境分布良好）时为 $d/n$。起决定作用的是维度……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文证明在高斯 ICA 中分离某个成分的代价由其在各环境方差签名所对应的 Riesz 2-能量刻画，并据此给出样本复杂度的维度定律：环境数 K=2、3 及 K≥4 时分别需要 d²/n、d·log d/n 与 d/n 量级的样本。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the cost of separating the j-th Gaussian component in ICA is characterized by the Riesz 2-energy of its variance signature across environments, yielding a dimension law for sample complexity: d²/n, d·log d/n, and d/n samples for K=2, 3, and K≥4 well-spread environments.
